Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly extracted the release date for "Cairo Declaration (Film)" as 1943, which conflicts with the initial search result. This misinterpretation led to an incorrect conclusion that "Cairo Declaration" came out first, when in fact "Natürlich Die Nelli" was released earlier in 1959.
